destination.title: Inflation driven by Kähler moduli
destination.question: Which source-specific stabilization and correction mechanisms allow Kähler saxions or axions to drive inflation, with a stable endpoint where addressed?
destination.summary: Collects concrete construction questions while retaining distinct poly-instanton, racetrack, perturbative, uplifting and higher-derivative mechanisms.

systems: Overall-volume, fibre, blow-up and other Kähler moduli
Kähler axions and mixed saxion–axion trajectories

assumptions: Correction mechanisms and uplift prescriptions are alternatives, not common requirements.

conventions: One complex Kähler modulus need not mean only its real part moves.

excludes: Assuming that a fibre geometry necessarily makes the fibre the inflaton
Inflation driven entirely by an independently identified open-string or brane sector

sources.title: Poly-instanton Inflation

evidence.text: Can poly-instanton effects generate viable single-field inflation from a fibre Kähler modulus while the total volume remains stabilized and perturbative corrections remain small enough to avoid the η-problem?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization and Inflationary Cosmology with Poly-Instantons in Type IIB Orientifolds

evidence.text: Can poly-instanton corrections stabilize a Wilson-line divisor's Kähler modulus in a controlled LARGE volume model and generate viable slow-roll inflation when that modulus is displaced?

sources.title: Accidental inflation from Kähler uplifting

evidence.text: Can single-Kähler-modulus inflation in the Kähler uplifting scenario support slow roll followed by a nearby metastable dS vacuum, including the quantum corrections considered in this paper?

sources.title: Accidental Kähler moduli inflation

evidence.text: Can racetrack tuning produce prolonged inflation near an inflection point of a small Kähler modulus while stabilizing the other moduli, reducing sensitivity to string-loop corrections and relaxing the required gauge-rank hierarchy?

sources.title: Starobinsky-Type Inflation from $\alpha'$-Corrections

evidence.text: Can higher-derivative α′³ corrections generate a controlled, finite-width Starobinsky-type inflationary plateau for a Kähler modulus, with string loops supplying stabilization and a graceful exit?

sources.title: Inflating in perturbative LVS: global embedding and robustness

evidence.text: Can overall-volume inflation in perturbative LVS be embedded in a concrete Calabi–Yau orientifold, with a justified single-field approximation and robustness against explicitly identified winding-loop and higher-derivative F4 corrections?

sources.title: Three-field string inflation with perturbative corrections: Dynamics and implications

evidence.text: Can perturbative corrections stabilize three Kähler saxions in a type IIB motivated large-volume model and produce observationally viable three-field inflation with transient turning, torsion and slow-roll violation?

sources.title: Perturbative Kähler Moduli Inflation

evidence.text: Can perturbative corrections stabilize multiple Kähler saxions and support inflation driven by a blow-up modulus while satisfying the paper's EFT, Kähler-cone and cosmological constraints?

sources.title: Eternal inflation with alpha-prime-corrections

evidence.text: Can perturbative α′ corrections replace anti-D3 uplift while allowing volume-modulus slow-roll inflation, a stabilized de Sitter endpoint, and eternal inflation supplying initial conditions?

sources.title: Kahler moduli inflation

evidence.text: Can a Kähler modulus drive slow-roll F-term inflation within a stabilized type IIB flux compactification, avoiding the usual η problem without tuning inflationary parameters, and produce characteristic observable predictions?

sources.title: Inflating in a better racetrack

evidence.text: Can a computed two-Kähler-modulus potential from an explicit type IIB compactification support racetrack-like axionic inflation, with stabilized radial directions and an observationally acceptable perturbation spectrum?

sources.title: Kähler moduli inflation and WMAP7

evidence.text: Do effective single-field Kähler-moduli inflation potentials from explicit type-IIB large-volume compactifications produce sufficient e-folding, a suitable scalar spectral index and suitable running relative to the historical WMAP7 ranges? A simpler exponential toy potential is also analyzed.

sources.title: Assisted Fibre Inflation in perturbative LVS

evidence.text: Can two K3-fiber moduli assist inflation in perturbative LVS, reducing each canonical field's excursion while maintaining volume stabilization and cosmological observables compatible with the observational datasets quoted by the paper?

sources.title: On Global Embeddings of Assisted Fibre Inflation

evidence.text: Can multiple fibre moduli share the excursion needed for sufficient inflation, permitting global embeddings within individual Kähler-cone limits? This proceedings article explicitly reviews the authors' earlier assisted-fibre-inflation work.

sources.title: Tetra-quadric CY Threefold and Assisted Fibre Inflation

evidence.text: Can three Kähler volume moduli in a tetra-quadric orientifold collectively drive fibre inflation, sharing the required large effective field excursion while maintaining volume stabilization and a usable effective description?

sources.title: Kähler moduli inflation and WMAP7

evidence.text: Diagonalize volume expressions, normalize the inflaton using the Kähler metric, and approximate the e-fold integral and potential slow-roll parameters. Translate these into ns, αs and r and compare their ranges with the quoted WMAP7 data.

sources.title: Poly-instanton Inflation

evidence.text: Compute the supergravity F-term potential, minimize axions and separate leading V^−3 stabilization from subleading V^(−3−p) poly-instanton effects. Then minimize the latter with the heavy moduli fixed.

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization and Inflationary Cosmology with Poly-Instantons in Type IIB Orientifolds

evidence.text: Compute the N=1 F-term potential from K=−2 ln(V+Cα′) and the nonperturbative superpotential. Expand in inverse volume and poly-instanton exponentials, solve leading extrema, then analyze the subleading Wilson-line potential analytically and numerically.

sources.title: Accidental inflation from Kähler uplifting

evidence.text: Constructs benchmarks by numerically imposing flatness near the CMB point and approximately vanishing vacuum energy and gradient at the final minimum. Evolves the noncanonically normalized modulus using covariant background equations.

sources.title: Accidental Kähler moduli inflation

evidence.text: Tunes racetrack coefficients to obtain a sufficiently flat inflection region, then numerically follows the full field equations using canonical momenta and forward e-fold time. This formulation avoids directly computing Christoffel symbols in the evolution equations.

sources.title: Starobinsky-Type Inflation from $\alpha'$-Corrections

evidence.text: Classify exponential terms by coefficient signs, arrange one higher-derivative term to dominate the observable inflationary interval, and complete a square with the relevant positive loop term. Shift the canonical field to express left- and right-rolling potentials around their uplifted minima.

sources.title: $\alpha^′$ -Corrections and de Sitter vacua - A mirage?

evidence.text: Can leading perturbative α′ corrections, together with tuned flux superpotential, stabilize Kähler volumes in nonsupersymmetric Minkowski/de Sitter vacua and support Kähler-modulus slow-roll inflation without nonperturbative stabilization?

sources.title: Non-perturbative stabilization of two Kähler moduli in type-IIB/F theory and the inflaton potential

evidence.text: Does extending nonperturbative stabilization from one to two Kähler moduli, together with perturbative Kähler corrections and D-term uplift, produce slow-roll plateau potentials and viable inflationary parameters?

sources.title: String Loop Moduli Stabilisation and Cosmology in IIB Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Under what geometric and perturbative conditions can type IIB LARGE Volume Scenarios stabilize Kähler moduli, and what inflationary and finite-temperature cosmology follows?

sources.title: An Effect of alpha' corrections on racetrack inflation

evidence.text: Can leading perturbative α′ corrections to the Kähler potential change volume stabilization and the onset of racetrack inflation at radii where perturbation theory remains reliable, and when can those corrections safely be neglected?

sources.title: Recent progress on inflation and dark energy from string theory

evidence.text: How can type IIB Kähler moduli generate inflation, perturbative reheating, and late-time dark energy while maintaining theoretical control and acceptable mass scales? This is a review of existing constructions, emphasizing loop blow-up inflation and axion hilltop quintessence.

sources.title: Moduli stabilisation and inflation in type IIB/F-theory

evidence.text: Can perturbative corrections in a type IIB/F-theory effective model stabilize Kähler moduli at positive vacuum energy, and can an additional Fayet–Iliopoulos contribution permit volume-modulus slow-roll inflation?

sources.title: Two-field Kahler moduli inflation on large volume moduli stabilization

evidence.text: Expand the supergravity potential through the stated order 1/V³, separating dominant volume/heavy-modulus terms from light-modulus corrections. Stabilize heavy axions at aiθi=π and impose approximate stationarity in the volume and heavy geometric directions.

sources.title: Kahler Moduli Inflation Revisited

evidence.text: Numerically integrate the covariant Kähler-field equations in spatially flat FRW, including Hubble friction, field-space connection terms and the Friedmann constraint. Displace τ2, locate conditional minima in other directions and subsequently test trajectories starting away from them.

sources.title: Multi-Field Inflation from String Theory

evidence.text: Numerically determine potential minima and solve all retained background field equations, then transform to approximately canonical fields and calculate perturbation spectra and tilts at Hubble exit.

sources.title: Roulette inflation with Kahler moduli and their axions

evidence.text: Estimate scalar and tensor spectra using the single-inflaton approximation along each trajectory: Ps=[H/(2πMP)]²e^(2us)/(2ε), with r≈16ε. Assess self-reproduction by comparing local stochastic kicks with classical drift, treating the metric as approximately constant over a fluctuation.

sources.title: Two-field Kahler moduli inflation on large volume moduli stabilization

evidence.text: Integrate background equations with fourth-order Runge–Kutta. Solve the coupled gauge-invariant perturbation equations twice for independent initial curvature and entropy vacuum modes, initialized deep inside the Hubble radius with cutoff ratio Cq≈100; combine the solutions into spectra and their cross-correlation.

sources.title: Two-field Kahler moduli inflation on large volume moduli stabilization

evidence.text: Redefine light fields proportionally to τi^(3/4), then rotate to φ and χ. The subsequent analysis uses a diagonal field-space metric with components 2cos²α and 2sin²α, where cos(2α)=9(φ²−χ²)/8.

evidence.text: Normalize the kinetic metric at the extremum, transform the complete Hessian, and diagonalize before assigning stability. This operation keeps mixing responsible for a light direction that is missed by the τ_b diagonal curvature.

sources.title: LVS de Sitter vacua are probably in the swampland

sources.title: Towards an explicit model of large field inflation

evidence.text: Asymptotic KS–KT charge matching estimates leading throat backreaction. Numerical minimization of the uplifted LVS potential along the cascade determines V(ψ), τ(ψ), averaged slow-roll corrections, and the corrected field distance through dφ = f̃(V(ψ))dψ.

sources.title: Inflationary α-attractor from type-IIB/F theory
